_comment: Content-app catalog for the source scout: ONLY apps listed here are ever set up as sources (allowlist - banking/private-comms apps are structurally excluded by omission). 'source' is the browse-cache source name. 'autoAdd': true = set up automatically with a visible announcement card the user can dismiss to cancel ('evogent should just work'); false = ask first (messaging-hybrid apps where public/private surfaces blur). 'discoveryNotes' feed the one-time discovery session.

com.instagram.android.name: Instagram
com.instagram.android.discoveryNotes: Home feed and Explore; posts usually expose author + caption via a11y descs. NEVER open Direct/DM surfaces — private messages are off-limits.

com.reddit.frontpage.name: Reddit
com.reddit.frontpage.discoveryNotes: Home/Popular feeds; post titles + subreddit in the tree. Skip chat.

com.zhiliaoapp.musically.name: TikTok
com.zhiliaoapp.musically.discoveryNotes: For You captions/authors; video content itself is not readable — capture text metadata only. Skip inbox/DMs.

com.linkedin.android.name: LinkedIn
com.linkedin.android.discoveryNotes: Main feed posts; skip messaging and My Network notifications.

com.instagram.barcelona.name: Threads
com.instagram.barcelona.discoveryNotes: Text-first feed, likely rich a11y descs like X.

com.facebook.katana.name: Facebook
com.facebook.katana.discoveryNotes: News feed only; skip Messenger, groups DMs, marketplace.

com.google.android.apps.magazines.name: Google News
com.google.android.apps.magazines.discoveryNotes: For You / Headlines; article titles + publishers in the tree.

com.google.android.apps.youtube.music.name: YouTube Music
com.google.android.apps.youtube.music.discoveryNotes: Home recommendations; use private runtime taste and feedback to decide which media belongs in-feed.

com.substack.app.name: Substack
com.substack.app.discoveryNotes: Inbox + Notes; note Substack posts also arrive via Gmail — prefer whichever is richer.

com.ideashower.readitlater.pro.name: Pocket
com.ideashower.readitlater.pro.discoveryNotes: Saves list — the user's own reading queue.

com.spotify.music.name: Spotify
com.spotify.music.discoveryNotes: Followed shows and recommendations; use private runtime taste to choose useful item types.

org.telegram.messenger.name: Telegram
org.telegram.messenger.discoveryNotes: PUBLIC channels the user follows ONLY. Never open private chats or groups — treat anything with a person's name as private.

com.discord.name: Discord
com.discord.discoveryNotes: Public server announcement channels only; never DMs.
